A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''member''' of the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Species/Legends|species]] worked as a bodyguard for a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified Bagman|courier]] hired to deliver a satchel of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Prit Kessek]]. The Houk was to accompany the courier from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Junction]], where he picked up the credits, to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Bazarre]] via [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]]. The Houk could read and write in [[Houkese]] and whilst on the job he carried a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|Heavy blaster pistol]] and a [[Vibroknife/Legends|Vibroknife]].<ref name="ZT" />

{{RPG}}
The Houk successfully accompanied the Human as far as the [[Grand Terminal]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on Junction, but there they were ambushed by a group of hired [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]]. The spacers planned to capture the courier and impersonate him in order to get close to Prit, and then [[Atlee Thanda]], a [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] for whom the credits were meant.<ref name="ZT" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Houk first appeared in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] adventure ''[[Zygerrian Takedown]]'' which was released online by [[Wizards of the Coast]] and designed by [[Jason Fry]] in [[2003]]. The adventure presents several possible scenarios for the ambush and does not require that the Houk survive or be [[Death/Legends|killed]] in order for the adventure to continue.
